getting-started.title: Getting started
getting-started.description: Overview of Velbok and how your studio uses the platform.

sections.heading: What is Velbok?
paragraphs: Velbok is a cloud-based studio management platform for tattoo and piercing shops. It combines scheduling, client records, deposits, consent forms, invoicing, messaging, and a customer portal in one application.
Your team signs in at the studio app (/auth). Clients interact through optional customer accounts and secure links for deposits and consent.

sections.heading: Who uses what
bullets: Studio owners & admins — full access, billing, permissions, settings
Artists — schedule, clients, stencils, deposits (based on permissions)
Front desk / assistants — schedule and inbox (when granted)
Customers — portal for bookings, payments, consent, and messages

sections.heading: First login
paragraphs: Use the email and password provided when your studio was onboarded. If you forgot your password, use Forgot password on the login page (requires email to be configured for your instance).
After login, staff are routed to the schedule. Customers are routed to their account portal.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Book appointments, manage artists, and view day or week calendars.

sections.heading: Views
bullets: Day view — hourly grid for selected artist(s)
Week view — overview across the week
Filter by artist using the sidebar checkboxes

sections.heading: Creating a booking
paragraphs: Click an empty slot or use the new booking control. Enter client name, contact details, service type, duration, and notes. Assign the responsible artist.
Booking types include tattoo sessions, consultations, touch-ups, and piercings depending on your studio configuration.

sections.heading: Booking details
bullets: Mark deposit paid or send a deposit payment link
Update status (confirmed, completed, cancelled, no-show)
Link a customer account when the client has registered
Open consent form flow for eligible tattoo/piercing bookings

sections.heading: Tips
sections.note: Artist colours and sidebar preferences are saved in your browser per device.

clients.title: Clients & CRM
clients.description: Import, search, and manage your client database.

sections.heading: Client list
paragraphs: The Clients area shows everyone your studio has booked or imported. Search by name, email, or phone.

sections.heading: CSV import
bullets: Prepare a CSV with columns for name, email, phone, and notes
Use Import on the Clients page and map columns
Review duplicates before confirming

sections.heading: Conduct tracking
paragraphs: No-shows, late cancellations, and reschedules can be recorded. Admins may ban clients from online booking when needed.

deposits.title: Deposits & payments
deposits.description: Collect deposits via Stripe and track payment status on bookings.

sections.heading: Stripe setup
paragraphs: Your studio instance must have Stripe keys configured by an administrator. Once active, staff can generate checkout links from booking details or the Deposits area.

sections.heading: Deposit workflow
bullets: Create or open a booking on the schedule
Generate a deposit link and send it to the client
When paid, the booking shows deposit paid automatically (via webhook)
VIP clients may be exempt from deposits if flagged on the booking

sections.heading: Customer payment page
paragraphs: Clients open secure checkout links without needing a staff login. Logged-in customers can also pay from their account portal under Deposits.

billing.title: Billing & invoices
billing.description: Create invoices, templates, and send payment requests.

sections.heading: Invoices
bullets: Create invoices linked to clients and companies
Add line items manually or from saved templates
Send invoice emails with Stripe payment when configured
Track status: draft, sent, paid, overdue

sections.heading: Companies
paragraphs: Studios with separate legal entities can assign bookings and invoices to the correct company record for accounting.

pos-checkout.title: POS checkout & Tap to Pay
pos-checkout.description: Take in-person card payments with your phone — no separate card reader required — or with a WisePad.

sections.heading: No separate card reader required
paragraphs: Velbok supports Stripe Tap to Pay: your staff phone becomes the payment terminal. The customer holds a contactless card or their mobile wallet near the top of your device — the same way they would tap on a shop terminal.

You do not need to buy a WisePad or other Stripe hardware for this mode. Tap to Pay uses Stripe Terminal in the background (connection token and a Terminal location on your studio’s Stripe Connect account), but no physical reader is paired or registered in Stripe Dashboard.
Use the Velbok mobile app (Android or iPhone), open Checkout, choose Tap to Pay (this phone), tap Enable phone payments, then Charge as usual.

sections.heading: What customers can pay with
bullets: Contactless debit and credit cards (tap)
Google Pay (Android)
Apple Pay (iPhone and many Android wallets)
Samsung Pay and other NFC mobile wallets
Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover contactless (region-dependent)
sections.note: Wallet payments usually do not need a PIN. Some high-value or regional card rules may require a PIN or a different payment method — Velbok will show Stripe’s on-screen prompt if that happens.

sections.heading: Stripe setup (no hardware purchase)
bullets: Finish Stripe Connect for your studio (Admin → POS checkout)
Create a Terminal location in Velbok — Admin → POS → Create Terminal location (Velbok saves this on your Connect account)
Enable POS checkout for staff
Install the release Velbok app on a compatible phone — not a debug build. Download from https://velbok.com/download
There is no separate “enable Tap to Pay” switch in Stripe for Velbok; you only need Connect + Terminal location
You only register a reader serial number in Stripe Dashboard if you use a physical device (e.g. WisePad 3)

sections.heading: Supported Android phones (Tap to Pay)
paragraphs: Stripe maintains the authoritative list; Velbok follows the same requirements. Phones must have NFC, Android 13+, Google Play Services, and Stripe’s security hardware (hardware keystore with ECDH). Developer options must be OFF for live payments.
bullets: Google Pixel — Pixel 6 and newer (6, 6a, 6 Pro, 7 series, 8 series, 9 series, 10 series, Pixel Fold)
Samsung Galaxy S — S22, S22+, S22 Ultra, S23 series, S24 series, S25 series, S26 series
Samsung Galaxy Z — Z Flip4, Z Flip5, Z Flip6, Z Flip7, Z Flip7 FE, Z Fold4, Z Fold5, Z Fold6, Z Fold7, Z TriFold
Samsung Galaxy A / M / F — many recent models (e.g. A14 5G and newer A-series, A53 5G+, M14 5G+, F34 5G+) — see Stripe link below for the full list
Samsung — Tab Active5 series, XCover7, XCover7 Pro, Wide8
Motorola — edge series (2022+), razr / razr+ (2022+), many moto g models with NFC
OnePlus — 10 series and newer, Nord 3 5G+, Open
Xiaomi / Redmi — 12 series and newer, many Note 13+ / 14+ models, MIX Flip / MIX Fold
Honor, Oppo, Asus ROG/Zenfone, Infinix — numerous models listed by Stripe

sections.heading: Android phones that do NOT work
bullets: Samsung Galaxy S21, S20, S10 and older S-series flagships — missing required security hardware (confirmed: S21 Ultra fails; use S22+ or WisePad)
Any phone without NFC or without hardware keystore ECDH (Stripe error TAP_TO_PAY_UNSUPPORTED_DEVICE)
Rooted phones, emulators, or phones without Google Play Services
Android 12 or older
Debug Velbok installs or phones with Developer options ON (for live Tap to Pay)

sections.heading: iPhone (Tap to Pay on iPhone)
bullets: Compatible iPhone with NFC — generally iPhone XS or later
iOS 16.4 or later
Velbok iOS app with Apple’s Tap to Pay on iPhone entitlement (studio owner requests this from Apple for the app)
Same customer payment types: contactless cards and Apple Pay
Stripe Connect + Terminal location in Velbok Admin → POS, same as Android

sections.heading: WisePad and other readers (optional)
paragraphs: If your phone is not supported, or you prefer a dedicated device, use WisePad (Bluetooth) in Checkout. WisePOS E and Stripe Reader S700 work as Wi‑Fi/standalone readers. Register WisePad serial numbers in Stripe Dashboard → Terminal → Readers on your Connect account.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
bullets: Install the latest release APK from https://velbok.com/download — uninstall old Velbok first if needed.
Tap Test Stripe server link on Checkout to verify Connect + Terminal location before Enable
Allow Location permission for Velbok (required by Stripe Terminal on Android)
Turn Developer options OFF and restart the phone if Stripe reports an insecure environment
Galaxy S21 users: switch to WisePad mode or use a Galaxy S22+ / Z Flip7+ phone for Tap to Pay

consent.title: Consent forms
consent.description: Digital tattoo and piercing consent with signatures and PDF export.

sections.heading: When to use
paragraphs: Consent is required for eligible tattoo and piercing appointments. Staff or clients complete the form before the session.

sections.heading: Process
bullets: Open consent from a booking or send the client link
Client reads health questions and studio policies
Electronic signature captured with timestamp
PDF stored for your records

sections.heading: Data storage
paragraphs: Consent records are retained for legal, medical, and insurance purposes as stated in your studio privacy policy.

customer-portal.title: Customer portal
customer-portal.description: What clients see when they sign in to their account.

sections.heading: Account features
bullets: Upcoming and past bookings
Pay deposits and view invoice status
Complete consent forms
Message the studio (when inbox is enabled)
Profile and security settings

sections.heading: Inviting customers
paragraphs: Admins invite customers from the Admin panel. Invited users receive an email to set a password and access the portal.

inbox.title: Inbox & messaging
inbox.description: Staff–client chat threads with optional email notifications.

sections.heading: Threads
paragraphs: Each conversation is tied to a client. Staff with inbox permission can reply, attach media, and see typing indicators when active.

sections.heading: Email notifications
sections.note: When SMTP is configured, clients can receive email alerts for new messages. Configure templates and sender details in your studio environment.

stock.title: Stock management
stock.description: Track supplies, suppliers, and artist stock requests.

sections.heading: Stock items
bullets: Maintain a catalogue of supplies with quantities
Link items to suppliers
Artists submit stock requests for approval

sections.heading: Using stencils
paragraphs: Artists with stencil permission can upload reference images and generate stencil variations in several styles, each named after a capital city — Paris signature line, London traditional, Tokyo fine line, Rome sketch, Berlin dotwork, and Madrid blackwork. Each style shows an example render you can tap to enlarge, so you can see how its lines look before generating.

AI generation is metered: each account can produce up to 10 AI stencils over any rolling 24-hour period. A live countdown shows how many generations remain, and a failed render does not count against it.

Generated stencils are kept in storage for 24 hours so they can be re-opened and re-downloaded from the Recent stencils folder, then automatically deleted. The Basic in-browser engine is free and unmetered.
sections.note: Basic mode runs entirely in the browser and is free. AI mode renders professional stencils through Netlify AI Gateway with no API keys to manage.
